_rule: met = the page in that journal row (the page seen BEFORE that step's action) already satisfied the goal. Fixture-site truth comes from tests/fixtures/server.mjs: /docs shows 'The secret code is 4711.' only after the 'Show the secret code' button is clicked; /consent is only satisfied once the dialog is gone (Accept all removes it client-side, the URL never changes); the cart goal is satisfied by the POSTed 'Cart' page ('Added 1 × Red Gadget to your cart.'); the dashboard page (after the login POST redirects) is the signed-in state; the contact goal is the POSTed 'Thanks, NAME!' page. A page that merely OFFERS a way to the goal is not met — that is §9.1's rule, and it is why a DuckDuckGo results page counts as not-met.
